notes.title: Meet the continuation of the game.
notes.content:
Hello, dear players. I am glad to present you the continuation of the game about Bari Sue.
Without any DLS or paid patches, I offer you a short but exciting continuation in which you will have to try your hand at some works.
For players who have already purchased the game, it is possible to launch the add-on using a separate button in the menu, without having to go through the first day (especially hated accounts) again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038307/99d1272e6492547a79e8a4ec350a0e311aed0f3a.jpg[/img]

Brief description of the update:
- a large number of bugs have been fixed
- 3 additional levels with new locations
- now the game will work more stable on weak computers

If you have any difficulties or problems with the game, write to us by email. Good luck:)
